subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: For this exact head, should gateway maintainers require redacted live WeChat A+B QR-login proof, or accept the focused gateway lifecycle regressions once the current health-monitor concern is resolved?
rationale: Only a gateway owner can set the acceptable proof bar for a provider-backed lifecycle change after the contributor has accurately stated that their environment cannot run a real WeChat session.

options.title: Require live provider proof
options.body: Hold merge until a real WeChat setup shows that account A remains online after account B QR login on the reviewed head.

options.title: Waive provider proof
options.body: Explicitly accept focused lifecycle regressions and normal CI as sufficient after the remaining health-recovery behavior is resolved.

recommendation.title: Require live provider proof
recommendation.body: Hold merge until a real WeChat setup shows that account A remains online after account B QR login on the reviewed head.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged gateway reload work makes this the strongest available technical routing candidate, although the proof-policy decision may need a broader gateway owner.
